register.headline: Polkovskyi's lower re-solve at 204 of Couzo's packing, 1.48e-11 below T-229
register.source_checks: The author's comment of 23 October says he imported this repository's sqpack/verify.py as a module in a batch harness that parsed each certificate and called its pair-overlap and containment routines, and ran Evan Daniel's verify_cert.py and verify_cert2.py as archived in Francisco Couzo's repository at 6b7391d. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit Francisco Couzo's packing, first reported in #670 and refined in #675 and #678 (T-226, T-228, T-223), re-solved to a smaller side by Mykhailo Polkovskyi (https://github.com/Mishapolk/square-packing-records), whose continuous SQP optimization started from Couzo's #678 certificate in Couzo's frame, as his comment of 23 October on issue 719 says; Couzo's source credits Polkovskyi's own construction as the seed of its search (hop job 105412).
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay of 204 (think-tetq); once at V3/C3, adopt it as the house and regularize it (think-h01y).

bibliography.note: The second 204 file of issue 719's release, certificates/n204.cert at 12fc46678fa8eefa3f156ff37dfffd84c8f3a580, first committed at 1851c2c, which the author's comment of 22 October claims: a re-solve of Couzo's #678 packing, started from that certificate by continuous SQP, 1.48e-11 below the release's n-204.cert (T-229).
